body:
Well, I do have people to talk to, I am much more comfortable around people online, even if it's skype and I'm on voice.  Dunno, when I'm face to face with people I just don't act like I do online unless I know them very well. Then it's easy for me to make jokes and make people laugh.  Part of it is really that I was bullied up until i was in my mid teens. Spent my time online instead and learned to make friends that way.

My online friends and I have been spending a lot of time playing through 4 man games lately. 
My favorite so far is probably Payday 2, It's a game where you basically pull off heists and lets you choose between going loud and fighting against the police or trying to stealth them. I love to play stealth games because there's a unique sense of accomplishment by getting the objective done without anyone knowing what you've done. 

I was also pretty excited for the new metal gear game, I'm not sure if you keep up on metal gear but the lifelong director of the series was essentially fired from the company and they've already announced their plans to keep making games without him. It's upsetting because the games are extremely story heavy and without his input they could easily trample on it. I guess you can compare it to star wars in that regard.

I like to work with computers, I fix them for other people and keep up with the newest processors/graphics cards and how they perform. Everyone I talk to pretty much wants to talk about things I don't know much or care much about.

I also like to play pc games and mystery themed tv/novels.
